MinHook v1.3.4
Source: https://github.com/TsudaKageyu/minhook
Commit: c3fcafdc10146beb5919319d0683e44e3c30d537
Included: upstream src/, include/ and LICENSE.txt, with the local changes below.
This is a third-party dependency, separate from the project's original code.

Local Tanto changes:
- Explanatory comments are marked "Local Tanto note"; upstream licenses and decoder tables are retained.
- hook.c EnableHook passes ACTION_DISABLE when disabling a single target.
  The upstream path always passed ACTION_ENABLE, so ProcessThreadIPs skipped enabled hooks
  instead of translating suspended trampoline instruction pointers back to the original function.
- tests/native/minhook_disable_cases.c reproduces the pre-fix failure with owned executable memory
  and mocked thread APIs, then checks single-target and batch disable through the real hook lifecycle.
  The fixture runs through the existing offline test entrypoints; it creates no game or peer thread.
  This demonstrates a context-translation defect, not a live-game crash.
